Select Assets > Numbers menu on the Webex Connect platform and choose the Short Code option from the Get Numbers drop-down list box.

 [Image: Screenshot of Numbers Page.] 
Numbers Page

Select the country for which you need the Short Code and provide the following details in the Request Description field:

- Prefered series of shortcode (3xxxxx, 4xxxx, 5xxxx, 6xxxx)

- SMS volume you estimate to send using the shortcode

- Time period for which you need to hold the shortcode (6 months, 1 year, or permanent)

- An email and a phone number for communication.

## 🚧
Shortcode Allocation

Webex Connect operations team will contact you within 24 hours after you place the request.

## 

DLT Registered Numbers

 [Image: Entity ID for number registered on the DLT portal] 
Entity ID for number registered on the DLT portal

Only numbers registered against your DLT primary entity can be used for SMS communications within India.

In the Short Code page > Registered on the DLT portal section >, select your Entity ID from the Entity ID drop-down menu.
